summary: Build a corporate learning academy with curriculum blueprints, competency mapping, delivery models, and measurable impact. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Corporate learning academy design structures an internal learning system around business priorities and measurable capability growth. For L&D managers, trainers, HR partners and talent-development professionals, the course supports building or improving an academy through competency mapping, curriculum and learner-journey design, and delivery planning with impact measurement.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to design, launch, or improve a corporate learning academy that supports business goals and measurable skill development.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation includes working knowledge of L&D operations, training needs analysis, and basic curriculum planning. No coding is required, and AI concepts are covered at an operational level through practical academy use cases rather than technical build work. Participants should come prepared to discuss their organization’s current learning model, target learner groups, and any existing competency frameworks, LMS reports, or learning metrics they can share for workshop exercises.
